tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (.stApp). Never pure black: softer on the eyes for long sessions.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards: question card, list rows, stat tiles.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered option, open expander, inputs, menus.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Sidebar and code blocks. Sits one step darker than bg.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges (decorative, not meaning-bearing).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: option rows, inputs, secondary buttons. 3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, question text, button labels. On bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken (11.5:1+).

tokens.name: ink-reading
tokens.usage: Long reading text: options, explanations, notes. Slightly dimmer than ink to cut glare. On all surfaces (9.6:1+).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Meta text: tags, due date, captions, inactive nav. On all surfaces (5.5:1+).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Hints and keyboard shortcuts only. On bg, surface and surface-sunken (4.5:1+); not on surface-raised.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Sage green: links, active nav item, selected option marker, focus ring. On all surfaces (7.3:1+).

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Primary button fill (Submit, Next). Holds on-accent-fill.

tokens.name: on-accent-fill
tokens.usage: Label on accent-fill (7.4:1 slate, 6.8:1 sepia).

tokens.name: selected-bg
tokens.usage: Background of a chosen (not yet submitted) option row.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Correct answer text and icon. Always with a check icon and the word Correct.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Correct option row, Perfect banner ground.

tokens.name: success-border
tokens.usage: Edge of correct option / banner.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Wrong answer text and icon (muted terracotta). Always with an x icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Wrong option row, Incorrect banner ground, Hard Retry hover.

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Edge of wrong option / banner; Hard Retry border.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Missed answer, partial credit, Simple Retry, Medium difficulty, Reattempt badge.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Missed option row, partial banner ground.

tokens.name: warning-border
tokens.usage: Edge of missed option / partial banner.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Explanation heading and icon, Due date chip. On all surfaces (6.5:1+).

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Explanation panel ground.

tokens.name: bm-red
tokens.usage: Bookmark: Important.

tokens.name: bm-orange
tokens.usage: Bookmark: Review later.

tokens.name: bm-blue
tokens.usage: Bookmark: Interesting.

tokens.name: bm-purple
tokens.usage: Bookmark: Hard.

tokens.name: bm-green
tokens.usage: Bookmark: Solved.

styles.name: question
styles.sample: Which activation function avoids the vanishing gradient for positive inputs?
styles.usage: Question stem. ink on surface. Max width measure.

styles.name: option
styles.sample: ReLU, because its gradient is 1 for every x > 0.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: Batch normalisation rescales activations so each layer sees a stable input distribution.
styles.usage: Explanation, notes, long text. ink-reading, max width measure.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase overlines: SIDEBAR GROUPS, stat labels. ink-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips; inside badges.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between option rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Option row padding; button gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; between sections inside a card.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Question card padding on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, keyboard keys, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, option rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Bookmark chips, progress bar.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Question card only. Elsewhere use border, not shadow.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of question, options and explanation text (comfortable line length).

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Sidebar width.

tokens.name: target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of any clickable row or button.
